name: anthonyiles/worktree-isolation
description: Gives every git worktree of a PHP project its own dependencies, env files and databases.

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required for per-worktree MySQL/MariaDB databases (in the runtime that runs setup, test and clean).
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required for per-worktree PostgreSQL databases (in the runtime that runs setup, test and clean).
